help.example: Example: Samuel had 50 trading cards. On Monday he gave 5 of his trading cards to Rafael. On Tuesday he gave 6 to Julio. On Wednesday, he gave 9 to Juan. How many trading cards does Samuel have left?
help.exampleResult: Solution: Total = 50 trading cards Cards given away = 5 + 6 + 9 = 20 Cards left = Total – (Cards given away) = 50 – 20 = 30
